body.name: Palm intensity, expansion class, and uniform block regime
body.construction: For \(u\ge1\), set \(A_u=\{D(0)>u,R_{\mathrm c}(0)\le R(u),D(-j\Delta(u))\le u,\ j=1,\ldots,q(u)\}\), \(\lambda(u)=\Delta(u)^{-1}\Pr(A_u)\), \(\mathfrak E=\{u\mapsto\beta u+\gamma\log u+c:\beta>0,\gamma,c\in\mathbb R\}\), and \(\mathfrak L(u)=[u^3,\lambda(u)^{-1/2}]\). From the expansion coefficients set \(u_0=1+\max\{1,(-\gamma_{\star}/\beta_{\star})_+\}\) and \(T_0=\max\{e,\exp[\mathcal E_{\star}(u_0)]\}\). Only for \(T\ge T_0\), define \(b(T)\) as the unique solution in \([u_0,\infty)\) of \(\mathcal E_{\star}(b(T))=\log T\), define \(a(T)=1/\mathcal E_{\star}'(b(T))>0\), and then define \(h(T)\), \(u_{\mathrm p}(T)\), and \(M_T^{\mathrm{sim}}\) from the padded grid field in \(\texttt{def:canonical-localization}\). The marked process applies the same Palm root rule in the eventual subregime \(u_{\mathrm p}(T)\ge u_0\).
